title: Degreewise splitting of the explicit telescope sequence
statement: For universes u and v, let A : Type u be a commutative ring, P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) ℤ, F : ℕ → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) ℤ, ι n : F n ⟶ P, and step n : F n ⟶ F (n+1). Assume every ι n is monic, step n ≫ ι (n+1) = ι n, every x : P.X k equals (ι n).f k y for some n and y : (F n).X k, and every (step n).f k has a retraction r with (step n).f k ≫ r = id. Set S = ∐ F. Define a : S ⟶ S by a on summand n equal to Sigma.ι F n minus step n ≫ Sigma.ι F (n+1), and b : S ⟶ P by b on summand n equal to ι n. Compatibility gives a ≫ b = 0. Then for every k : ℤ the evaluated short complex S.X k → S.X k → P.X k admits a ShortComplex.Splitting: maps r_k and s_k with a_k ≫ r_k = id, s_k ≫ b_k = id and r_k ≫ a_k + b_k ≫ s_k = id. There is no K-projectivity hypothesis or conclusion.

proof.text: Evaluate at k. The evaluation functor preserves coproducts, and Cofan.isColimitMapCoconeEquiv identifies its mapped coproduct cocone with the cofan of the evaluated inclusions j_n. The coproduct universal property is used in the proved private helpers telescope_retraction and telescope_exact.

Form Functor.ofSequence from the evaluated transition maps and NatTrans.ofSequence from the compatible inclusions into P.X k. Exhaustion gives joint surjectivity of the underlying cocone of types. Monicity gives injectivity on each stage, satisfying Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' with the identity map as the equality witness. The module forgetful functor preserves these filtered colimits by factoring through AddCommGrpCat, and reflects isomorphisms, hence reflects this colimit. For a cokernel cofork q of a, the restrictions j_n q are compatible by the telescope summand formula and a q = 0. The colimit desc defines its unique factorization through b, with existence and uniqueness checked by coproduct and colimit extensionality. Consequently b is a cokernel of a and the evaluated short complex is exact.

Choose retractions r_n from the split-step hypothesis and define morphisms t_n recursively by t_0 = 0 and t_(n+1) = r_n composed with (t_n - j_n). Define l by the coproduct desc with restrictions t_n. For each n, the restriction of a followed by l is t_n - step_n r_n (t_n - j_n) = j_n, using the retraction equation. Coproduct extensionality gives a followed by l = identity. Every object used here is explicitly constructed from the supplied maps; no unproved existence theorem supplies data.

Exhaustion shows b is surjective: if x = iota_n(y), then j_n(y) is a lift. ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective makes b epi. Apply ShortComplex.Splitting.ofExactOfRetraction to the exact evaluated short complex, the proved retraction l, and this epi proof. This produces the required nonempty splitting in every degree without any remaining sorry.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09KL--09KM; J1 formalizes the degreewise admissible telescope construction. Exactness is proved using the filtered-colimit universal property instead of finite-support kernel calculations; the retraction is recursively constructed with the corrected negative sign. Mathlib supplies colimit recognition and Splitting.ofExactOfRetraction.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredTelescope_degreewise_splitting {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) ℤ)
    (F : ℕ → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) ℤ)
    (ι : ∀ n, F n ⟶ P) (step : ∀ n, F n ⟶ F (n + 1))
    (hmono : ∀ n, Mono (ι n))
    (hcompat : ∀ n, step n ≫ ι (n + 1) = ι n)
    (hexhaustive : ∀ (k : ℤ) (x : P.X k),
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (y : (F n).X k), (ι n).f k y = x)
    (hsplit : ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ),
      ∃ r : (F (n + 1)).X k ⟶ (F n).X k,
        (step n).f k ≫ r = 𝟙 ((F n).X k)) :
    ∀ k : ℤ, Nonempty
      (((ShortComplex.mk (filteredTelescopeMap F step)
        (filteredTelescopeAugmentation P F ι)
        (filteredTelescope_comp_zero P F ι step hcompat)).map
          (HomologicalComplex.eval (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (.up ℤ) k)).Splitting)
